split: held-out synthetic intake comparison; frozen before first full run
annotation_guidelines: cancel means an unambiguous request to cancel the entire order/purchase; address means correcting a domestic delivery destination; unknown includes negated, conditional, unsupported, information-only or conflicting requests. The model cannot choose identity, money, approval or physical warehouse facts.
